scripts.clean: rm -rf public/js public/css public/mix-manifest.json build-report.json .webpack node_modules/.cache public/hot 2>/dev/null; find public/js public/css -type f -name '*.js' -o -name '*.css' -o -name '*.map' 2>/dev/null | xargs rm -f 2>/dev/null || true; mkdir -p public/js public/css || true
scripts.prod: npm run clean && npm run production
scripts.build:fix: npm run clean && npm run production && echo 'Build completed with fixes applied'
scripts.clean:all: npm run clean && rm -rf node_modules/.cache .webpack public/hot storage/framework/views/*.php 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.rebuild: npm run clean:all && npm run production
scripts.build:verify: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const files=['public/js/backend-bundle.min.js','public/js/landing-app.min.js','public/css/backend-bundle.min.css','public/css/landing-page.min.css']; const missing=files.filter(f=>!fs.existsSync(f)); if(missing.length) {console.error('Missing files:', missing); process.exit(1);} else {console.log('All build files present');}"
